reason: Liquid chutneys in squeeze tubes always suffer from phase separation—you squeeze and a squirt of watery green juice shoots out first, soaking your momos or frankie. ₹99 is way too much money to risk on soggy snacks.
objection: The watery liquid will separate out in the tube and squirt out messily before any solid chutney appears.
would_change_my_mind: A proven thick-emulsion formula that guarantees zero liquid separation even after two weeks in the fridge.
